messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> HIGH: gpu-prod-38 reported sustained GPU memory pressure (>95%) for 30s, potential OOM. alert_id=PD-99321 :rotating_light:
pagerduty: Triggered on rotation policy: urgent-gpu-pool. Escalating to oncall schedule 'gpu-oncall'.
sam (oncall): Acked. I'm on it, pulling logs.
infra-bot: Attached recent node metrics: gpu_prod_38: memory_used=49.8GB / 52GB, vmem_swapback=4.1GB, nvml_errors=2, last_reclaim=42s ago.
mika: @sam any customer-facing requests affected? I see a spike in 502s from model-infer-west2.
sam (oncall): Checking traces — looks like requests to /v1/generate for model-xq-13 had elevated tail latency and 500s starting ~1767894260. Customer impact small subset (1 region).
lee: Running quick kubectl: `kubectl -n inference logs -l pod=gpu-prod-38 -c runtime | tail -n 80` shows repeated "CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY" and `nvmlDeviceGetMemoryInfo` warnings.
sam (oncall): Copy of logs:
```
# recent
[2026-03-10T14:12:01Z] runtime: allocate 16384 bytes -> CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
[2026-03-10T14:12:01Z] kvcache: attempted reclaim 3MB, succeeded 0MB
[2026-03-10T14:12:02Z] runtime: swapback triggered, offloaded 4.1GB -> host (latency spike)
[2026-03-10T14:12:05Z] inference: response 500 model=xq-13 seq_len=2048
```

mika: Ok, seems like tail requests with long sequences plus kvcache churn causing swapback loops.
sam (oncall): Short-term mitigation: applying pool-immediate-evacuate on gpu-prod-38 to stop new allocations, and nudging auto-fallback to model-xq-13-quantized. Executing now.
infra-bot: Command ran: `platformctl pools evict --pool gpu-prod-38 --grace 30s` -> accepted.
lee: Noted increased fallback rate to quantized variant, request volumes rerouted. Monitoring for new OOMs.
mika: Notify SRE and Customer Success for customers in west2. I'll prepare a short blurb if impact persists.
sam (oncall): Running memory scrub job on node, kick off host reclaim: `ssh node@gpu-prod-38 sudo systemctl restart runtime-agent` (will produce brief connection drops). Proceeding after evict completes.
pagerduty: Incident status -> acknowledged by sam (oncall). Next escalation at +10m if still firing.
infra-bot: Observability note: enabled enhanced tracing on affected routes; sampling increased from 1%->25% for 10m.
mika: ETA for full recovery?
sam (oncall): If evict+restart clears kvcache churn, should see pressure fall within 2-3 minutes. If pressure persists, plan is to cordon node and reprovision (swap to larger GPU).
lee: After restart: nvml errors dropped, memory_used -> 22GB, swapback -> 0.4GB. 502/500 rate improving.
sam (oncall): Marking this as mitigated. Leaving PD incident open until 10m quiet. Posting post-incident notes to incidents channel after closure. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty: PD note: incident auto-resolve check scheduled in 10m.
mika: Thanks team. I'll flag customers impacted and prepare follow-up email if the spike reappears.
sam (oncall): Follow-ups: 1) root cause follow-up ticket to eng-runtime for kvcache eviction policy and long-seq protection; 2) add runtime guard to reject very long seqs for model-xq-13 under memory pressure; 3) run a sweep to identify other nodes with repeated swapback activity.
lee: I'll attach the logs + heap snapshots to the ticket.
sam (oncall): Closing thread once PD auto-resolves. Good job.
